stories.summary: Reddit’s stock plunged on Friday after the community-discussion forum said its search referral traffic was down significantly in the third quarter.

sports.title: Thunder say Holmgren out 8-10 weeks after knee procedure
sports.summary: Chet Holmgren will be out 8 to 10 weeks with a knee injury, the latest setback for an OKC team that lost Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace for an extended time early this week.

sports.title: Sources: Walter, Kushner finalize terms of Lakers sale at $12.5B valuation
sports.summary: Lakers owner Mark Walter and Thrive Capital founder Josh Kushner met Thursday to finalize the transaction and are expected to sign the formal agreement soon, sources told ESPN.

sports.title: Sources: Hart winner Kucherov, 33, requests trade from Lightning
sports.summary: Tampa Bay Lightning star forward Nikita Kucherov, 33, who is in the final year of an eight year, $76 million contract, has requested a trade from a club he led to two Stanley Cup titles, sources told ESPN on Friday night, confirming an earlier report.

sports.title: Morant, hurt against Grizzlies, to miss at least four weeks
sports.summary: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out at least four weeks.
